repair.amendment: Natural execution policy after retained attempt1, before attempt2; unchanged 1920 support/480 hop/960 delay, model bytes, inputs and reference eligibility. Overlap or unknown input shape rejects before consuming ambiguous PCM. No endpoint clamp or reference rounding.
